color.note: Values copied from the live stylesheet's :root and .dark blocks. The live site renders in the light theme only; the dark theme is defined in its CSS but unused. Unused scaffolding tokens (sidebar, popover, chart) are left out.

tokens.name: ivory
tokens.usage: The brand's page ground. Fixed in both themes; the live site's sticky header uses it at 90% opacity.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: The brand's near-black. Fixed in both themes. Use for the logo, primary buttons and body text on ivory.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: 1px dividers and the header's bottom rule on ivory. Decorative only: never the sole boundary of a control or the only cue for meaning.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page ground behind all content.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Headings and body text on `background`, `card` and `secondary`.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Card and panel surface; the same as `background` in light.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `card`.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary button fill and the strongest emphasis.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `primary`.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Quiet fills such as the product mockup's panels. Text on it uses `secondary-foreground`.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `secondary`.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Subtle backgrounds for chips and inactive areas.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text: eyebrows, nav links at rest, legal body copy and captions on `background` and `muted`.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Hover and selected fills. Not a brand hue: the Publius palette has no colored accent.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `accent`.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Error states and destructive actions only. Pair it with a word or icon.

tokens.name: destructive-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `destructive`. Meets 4.5:1 in light; in dark the source pair is about 3:1, so use it for large or bold text only.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Default 1px borders and dividers.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Form field borders. Pair with `ring` on focus.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus outline. Solid, 3:1 or better on `background` in both themes.

tokens.name: footer-sepia-top
tokens.usage: Top stop of the footer gradient. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: footer-sepia-mid
tokens.usage: Middle stop (45%) of the footer gradient. Also the warm block on the cover.

tokens.name: footer-sepia-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of the footer gradient.

tokens.name: testimonial-tint
tokens.usage: Flat background of the homepage testimonial band, between two sepia sections. Text on it uses `foreground` and `muted-foreground`.

tokens.name: footer-ink
tokens.usage: Text on the footer gradient. Its secondary text is this color at 80%, 60%, 50% and 40% opacity; the 40% copyright line falls below 4.5:1, so do not use 40% for anything that must be read.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Page H1. The live site sets it fluid with clamp(40px, 5vw, 72px); 72px is the maximum.

styles.name: heading-card
styles.usage: Section and card headings on legal and content pages.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Running text, set in `muted-foreground` on long legal pages and `foreground` elsewhere.
styles.sample: Publius connects scattered case files into a source-grounded matter workspace.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Footer copy and form helper text.
styles.sample: Subscribe to receive early access when we go live.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase label above each H1 and section heading. Set in `muted-foreground`.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Footer disclaimer and link row. Links are uppercase with 0.14em tracking.

spacing.note: The live site uses Tailwind's 4px scale. These are the values that define its layout.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of `container-x` at every width.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of `container-x`. Legal and long-form pages narrow to 768px.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Gap between a page heading block and its content.

tokens.name: section-y
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a page section below 768px.

tokens.name: section-y-lg
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a page section from 768px up.

tokens.name: radius-base
tokens.usage: Every button, field, card and image. The brand is square-cornered; do not round further.
